          krotix
          krotix To get right to the point, a beautiful and very atmospheric short collection of pieces. I do like Zoe's music. Favorite track: Possible.
          Tom Smith
          Tom Smith Beautiful, glorious music that fills you with hope. Lovely to hear more from Zoe. Favorite track: Forte.
          grognard
          grognard Every Zoe Keating album would have the same review; she creates a mathematical formula in a universe with laws of nature that shift with time and never end in the same place as where you're looking when you start.

          So beautiful that I can't help but feel intense yearning for something treasured yet lost. The magic that is Zoe's music though is that the same passage may be joyous or bleak, depending on your mood.

          It's definitely music I prefer to focus on, rather than have as a backdrop.
